info.name: Auth Service
info.description:
Complete Auth Service API collection.

## Auth flows

**Email:** Signup → Verify Email → Login → tokens

**Google:** Google Signup → Google Login → tokens

## Collection variables
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL (local: `http://localhost:3302`, prod: `https://auth.algoarena.co.in`) |
| `accessToken` | Auto-set after login / google login / refresh |
| `refreshToken` | Auto-set after login / google login / refresh |
| `verificationToken` | UUID from verification email link (`?token=...`) |
| `googleWebIdToken` | Google Sign-In ID token from web client |
| `googleIosIdToken` | Google Sign-In ID token from iOS client |

## Env vars (server)
`DATABASE_URL`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID`, `VERIFY_EMAIL_URL`

request.description:
Register with email and password. Sends verification email.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `DATABASE_URL`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `RESEND_FROM`, `VERIFY_EMAIL_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `name` | string | Yes | 2–100 chars |
| `email` | string | Yes | Valid email, must be unique |
| `password` | string | Yes | 8–128 chars |

**Response `201`:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "name": "Mohit Kumar",
  "email": "mohit@example.com",
  "role": "user",
  "isEmailVerified": false,
  "createdAt": "2026-05-31T..."
}
```

**Errors:** `400` user already exists, `500` email send failure

Verify email via browser link (same as clicking the email button).

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `DATABASE_URL`

| Param | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `token` | query string | Yes | UUID from verification email |

**Response `200`:** HTML success page — "Email verified"

**Response `400`:** HTML error page

Set `verificationToken` from the email link: `?token=<uuid>`

Verify email via JSON API (Postman / mobile apps).

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `token` | string | Yes | UUID from verification email |

**Response `200`:**
```json
{ "message": "Email verified successfully" }
```

**Errors:** `400` invalid or expired token

Register a new user with Google (web). Mirrors email signup — returns user profile, **no tokens**.

**Next step:** call `Google Login (Web)` to get tokens.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `idToken` | string | Yes | Google **ID token** from web. Token `aud` must match `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` |

**Response `201`:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "name": "Mohit Kumar",
  "email": "mohit@gmail.com",
  "role": "user",
  "isEmailVerified": true,
  "createdAt": "2026-05-31T..."
}
```

User is created with `provider=google`, `isEmailVerified=true`, avatar from Google.

**Errors:** `400` user already exists, `401` invalid Google token

Register a new user with Google (iOS). Same as web signup — returns user profile, **no tokens**.

**Next step:** call `Google Login (iOS)` to get tokens.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `idToken` | string | Yes | Google **ID token** from iOS SDK. Token `aud` must match `GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID` |

**Response `201`:** Same shape as web Google signup

**Errors:** `400` user already exists, `401` invalid Google token

Email/password login for web clients.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `email` | string | Yes | Valid email |
| `password` | string | Yes | Plain text password |
| `deviceType` | string | No | `web` or `mobile` (default: `web`) |
| `deviceName` | string | No | Default: `Chrome` when deviceType is web |

**Response `200`:**
```json
{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..."
}
```

**Errors:** `401` invalid credentials, `400` email not verified

Email/password login for mobile clients.

**Auth:** None

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `email` | string | Yes | Valid email |
| `password` | string | Yes | Plain text password |
| `deviceType` | string | No | Set to `mobile` |
| `deviceName` | string | No | Default: `Mobile App` when deviceType is mobile |

**Response `200`:** Same as web login — access + refresh tokens

Sign in with Google (web). User must already exist via `Google Signup (Web)`.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `idToken` | string | Yes | Google **ID token**. Token `aud` must match `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` |
| `deviceType` | string | No | `web` or `mobile` (default: `web`) |
| `deviceName` | string | No | Default: `Chrome` |

**Response `200`:**
```json
{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..."
}
```

**Errors:**
- `401` account not found (sign up first) or invalid token
- `400` account uses email login (wrong provider)

Sign in with Google (iOS). User must already exist via `Google Signup (iOS)`.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID`, `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `idToken` | string | Yes | Google **ID token** from iOS SDK |
| `deviceType` | string | No | Set to `mobile` for iOS |
| `deviceName` | string | No | e.g. `iPhone 15 Pro` |

**Response `200`:** access + refresh tokens

**Errors:** `401` account not found, `400` wrong provider

**Legacy endpoint** — auto-creates user if not found, then returns tokens in one step.

Prefer the split flow:
1. `POST /auth/google/signup`
2. `POST /auth/google/login`

**Auth:** None

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `idToken` | string | Yes | Google ID token |
| `deviceType` | string | No | `web` or `mobile` |
| `deviceName` | string | No | Device label |

**Response `200`:** access + refresh tokens

Rotate access and refresh tokens.

**Auth:** None (uses refresh token in body)

**Requires server env:** `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `refreshToken` | string | Yes | Current valid refresh token |

**Response `200`:**
```json
{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..."
}
```

Old refresh token is invalidated after rotation.

**Errors:** `401` invalid or expired refresh token

Revoke refresh token and delete linked session.

**Auth:** None (uses refresh token in body)

**Requires server env:** `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `refreshToken` | string | Yes | Refresh token to revoke |

**Response `200`:**
```json
{ "message": "Logged out successfully" }
```

**Errors:** `401` invalid refresh token

Get logged-in user profile.

**Auth:** Bearer `accessToken`

**Requires server env:** `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`

**Headers:**
| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{accessToken}}` |

**Response `200`:** Public user profile (no password hash)

**Errors:** `401` missing or invalid token

Update current user profile. All body fields are optional — send only fields you want to change.

**Auth:** Bearer `accessToken`

**Requires server env:** `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| `name` | string | No | 2–100 chars |
| `phone` | string | No | Max 20 chars |
| `countryCode` | string | No | Max 10 chars, e.g. `+91` |
| `avatar` | string | No | Max 500 chars, URL |

**Not updatable here:** `email`, `password`, `role`, `provider`

**Response `200`:** Updated public user profile

**Errors:** `401` unauthorized

List all non-deleted users.

**Auth:** None

**Requires server env:** `DATABASE_URL`

**Response `200`:** Array of user records from database

**Note:** Returns raw user objects — use with caution in production.
